added_paragraphs: Tong Keow Medical Hall is an established traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) shop and clinic with roots in Toa Payoh. Its company profile traces its founding to 1968 and describes a business now run by the second generation of family owners. Its range includes raw herbal materials such as American ginseng and monk fruit, alongside cooling teas, pills and medicinal plasters. This combination places traditional herbal goods alongside products for everyday care (Tong Keow Medical Hall, 2022; “Instagram Reel About Tong Keow Medical Hall,” n.d.).

The company’s promotional profile also describes consultations with registered TCM physicians and services such as acupuncture and cupping for concerns including indigestion, common colds and joint sprains (“Instagram Reel About Tong Keow Medical Hall,” n.d.). These services form part of the wider business’s advertised clinical role. Our Hougang visit focused on retail displays and staff accounts, with no consultation or clinical prescription recorded.

chain_before: The tutor described Tong Keow as a chain, and the directory links its Toa Payoh and Hougang outlets. Our photographs show branded soup packs alongside herbs, grains and other foods. The branding connects the branch to the wider business. We interpret the mixed range as central to its everyday role: herbal goods can be encountered during an ordinary food-shopping trip.
